items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: Joe Howard. He was a good Sousa horn player.

ctx.x: all right. And the alto horns and your baritone horns, tubas you know.

I'll get back in the background. Big Eddie Jackson on that Sousa horn. That was my favorite Sousa horn player. Big Eddie Jackson, Old Man Kimball too. Old Man Kimball played nice Sousa horn too. Eddie Jackson, Old Man Kimball, and I remember another good Sousa horn player. His name used to live on Simon Bob. Correct. No. Page. No. No, very not. He'd play clarinet, that's when I was playing Riddles Tuxedo. John Porter. John Porter. John Porter. And this other fella played good Sousa horn too which was a tremor…
of the desert. And this fella, he used to play at the Ricca Band until he died, Ferret. Ferret. You remember that? Ferret, yeah. He used to wear the apron. Yeah. He was pretty good. Yeah.
